topic: Loading a retirement plan with employer stock vs diversifying broadly (Duncan vs Priya)

scenes.narration: One worker kept his entire retirement inside his employer's stock. It collapsed in a month. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at an x-ray showing a single cracked egg in one basket, comic burst banner reads CONCENTRATION RISK CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Duncan and Priya work at the same company with identical salaries.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man duncan and woman priya in matching office badges, a sign behind them labeled SAME COMPANY SAME SALARY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both contribute ten percent of pay into their company retirement plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two paychecks each with a slice arrow labeled TEN PERCENT flowing into retirement jars, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Duncan loves his employer, so eighty percent sits in company stock.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man duncan hugging a giant stock certificate, a pie chart beside him stamped EIGHTY PERCENT COMPANY STOCK in red, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya spreads hers across a broad index fund of thousands of companies.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya holding a fan of thousands of tiny company cards, a pie chart labeled BROAD INDEX FUND in green, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Duncan's paycheck and his portfolio now depend on one single company.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man duncan balancing on a single thin pillar labeled ONE COMPANY, his paycheck and his nest egg both stacked on top, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Doctors call this concentration risk. One weak organ takes down everything.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding an anatomy chart of a body where every organ is stamped SAME COMPANY, a warning tag reads CONCENTRATION RISK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The company misses earnings badly and the stock falls sixty percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a newspaper page stamped EARNINGS MISS beside a stock chart arrow crashing labeled DOWN SIXTY PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Duncan's balance falls from four hundred thousand to roughly two hundred.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a balance meter sliding from FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND down to TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND, shocked man duncan watching, exam room, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya's index fund barely moves because one company is a sliver.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya calm beside a nearly flat chart line, a pie chart with one tiny sliver labeled ONE COMPANY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Layoffs follow. Duncan loses his job and his savings together.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man duncan carrying a cardboard box past a door stamped LAYOFFS, his empty retirement jar tucked under his arm, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Keep employer stock under ten percent of your retirement. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading EMPLOYER STOCK UNDER TEN PERCENT, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
